name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px solid #004499 focus ring with a 2px outer glow (4.5:1 contrast) on interactive elements. This ensures keyboard users see clear focus without losing context, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA. The glow improves visibility on varied backgrounds but slightly increases visual noise—accept that trade-off for inclusivity.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring with glow still risks blending into patterned backgrounds—especially on mobile where contrast drops. A 2px solid ring with a 4px outer glow (5:1 contrast) keeps focus clear without the noise. Test on real patterned backgrounds at 125% zoom to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Pick the 2px solid ring with 4px outer glow at 5:1 contrast.
It stays sharp on patterned backgrounds and mobile screens where a thicker ring blurs or fades. The extra glow adds a small visual load, but that’s better than losing focus visibility—WCAG 2.2 AA demands it.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring with 4px glow risks disappearing on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the glow blends into the pattern. A 3px solid ring with a 2px outer glow at 6:1 contrast keeps the focus sharp on all backgrounds without extra visual clutter—test it on a busy grid at 125% zoom to confirm.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px outer glow at 6:1 contrast. Ramp owns delivery of the CSS rule and test confirmation on patterned backgrounds at 125% zoom.
